target.title: fix(chat): preserve explicit current-source sends in Control UI history
target.body:
Related: #104544
Related: #83494

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where an agent could explicitly send a successful `message` tool reply to the exact current source conversation, while Control UI history omitted that delivered reply and showed only a later, different assistant final.

This PR addresses the explicit current-source `message` send slice of #104544. It does not address missing subagent lifecycle announcements, which are tracked separately in #105517.

## Why This Change Was Made

Explicit routes were excluded from message-tool history projection even when the resolved channel, account, target, and thread matched the current source conversation. The change adds a structured current-source route marker at the outbound owner and permits marker-backed successful explicit sends in the history projector.

Dry-run, suppressed, and explicit `ok: false` results remain excluded. Existing transcript delivery mirrors remain authoritative and are deduplicated.

## User Impact

Users who receive an explicit agent reply in the current Telegram/Slack source conversation can now see the same reply in Control UI session history. Later assistant output no longer replaces that delivered message in the dashboard.

Cross-channel, cross-account, cross-target, and cross-thread sends remain excluded from the current session history.

## Evidence

- Exact patch head: `dff6a7a7fb405c9c34c68be55135e87e26ac2187`
- Exact-head Control UI proof: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/29231673231
- Proof artifact: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/29231673231/artifacts/8271832525
- Patch CI: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/29231673102
- Pre-rebase exact-base comparison: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/29230562479
- Upstream baseline repair included by the rebase: #106132

The branch was replayed without patch-content changes onto upstream `main` at `b2b87e956e8b1ad197e37b3d81ea3649adea4761`. A commit-by-commit range comparison matched all seven patch commits. The prior architecture failure reproduced on the exact base and came from the raw SQLite allowlist baseline; upstream repaired that baseline in #106132 before this rebase.

The exact-head proof passed. It checks the focused gateway/outbound regressions, projects a confirmed current-source tool result through the production history projector, and renders the resulting history in the real Control UI with Playwright. Patch CI also passed on attempt 2. Attempt 1 had one unrelated TUI PTY timeout in `src/tui/tui-pty-local.e2e.test.ts` (outside this PR's changed files); the same job passed on replay without code changes.

## Risk And Rollback

Risk is limited to read-time history projection and the structured result metadata used to prove an exact current-source route. The marker is emitted only after trusted channel/account/target/thread resolution, and projection continues to reject existing non-success indicators.

Rollback is a straight revert of this PR. No config, schema, transcript migration, or persisted data rewrite is introduced.

## Documentation

No documentation change is needed. This restores consistency between an existing channel delivery path and the existing Control UI history surface without changing configuration or user-facing commands.
